query: What architecture is proposed in the paper?
expected_answer: The paper proposes the Transformer architecture based entirely on attention mechanisms.

query: Why does the Transformer remove recurrence?
expected_answer: To allow greater parallelization and reduce training time while maintaining translation quality.

query: What are the main components of the Transformer?
expected_answer: Encoder stack, decoder stack, multi-head attention, feed-forward networks, positional encoding, embeddings.

query: How many encoder layers are used in the base Transformer?

What is self-attention?
expected_answer: An attention mechanism relating different positions of a single sequence.

query: What is scaled dot-product attention?
expected_answer: Attention computed using Q, K, V where dot products are scaled by the square root of dk before softmax.

query: Why are attention scores divided by the square root of dk?
expected_answer: To prevent large dot products that push softmax into regions with very small gradients.

query: What is multi-head attention?
expected_answer: Multiple attention mechanisms running in parallel using different learned projections.
